title: AI Model Releases by Year
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: AI Capability Tracking
description: Interactive bar chart of major AI model releases per year across 11 frontier labs, showing the accelerating release pace from 2022 through partial-year 2026.

learningObjectives: Interpret a year-over-year bar chart of AI model release counts
Explain why a partial-year figure should not be compared directly to a full-year figure without adjustment

keyQuestions: How has the pace of major AI model releases changed since 2022?
Why is the 2026 total marked differently from prior years?
commonMisconceptions: Comparing the partial 2026 total directly to full-year totals without noting it covers only part of the year
assessmentOpportunities: Ask learners to project the full-year 2026 total from the partial figure

dataSource.name: AI Release Tracker
dataSource.note: Chart values live in ../ai-release-data/data.json, shared with five other MicroSims.
